general_rules.name: tutoiement_equipe_proche
general_rules.description: Use tu form and casual tone with direct team members (Lucas)
general_rules.trigger: Internal email to direct reports or close team members
general_rules.action: Use Salut greeting, tu form, first name only as closing

general_rules.name: vouvoiement_externe
general_rules.description: Always use vous form with external clients and partners
general_rules.action: Use formal greeting with title (Madame/Monsieur), vous form, full signature

general_rules.name: vouvoiement_hierarchie
general_rules.description: Use vous form with management and formal internal departments
general_rules.trigger: Email to CEO, finance, HR, or IT support
general_rules.action: Use Bonjour + first name or service name, vous form, full signature

general_rules.name: semi_formal_pairs
general_rules.description: Use semi-formal tone with peer colleagues (Pierre, Camille)
general_rules.action: Use Bonjour + first name or just first name, vous form, first name only as closing

general_rules.name: signature_externe
general_rules.description: Include full signature block for external contacts
general_rules.action: Add full signature: Sophie Martin + title + company + phone

general_rules.name: signature_interne_casual
general_rules.description: Use first name only for internal casual contacts
general_rules.trigger: Internal email to team members (casual tone)
general_rules.action: Sign with just Sophie or Sophi

general_rules.name: signature_interne_formal
general_rules.description: Use full signature for internal formal contacts
general_rules.trigger: Internal email to management, finance, or formal departments
general_rules.action: Add full signature with title and contact

general_rules.name: english_external_partners
general_rules.description: Switch to English for international partners
general_rules.action: Write in English with Hi/Dear greeting and Best regards closing

general_rules.name: numbered_lists_technical
general_rules.description: Use numbered lists for action items and specifications
general_rules.trigger: Technical discussions, specifications, or action items
general_rules.action: Structure content with numbered lists for clarity

general_rules.name: bullet_points_status
general_rules.description: Use bullet points for status updates and summaries
general_rules.trigger: Sprint planning, status reports, meeting recaps
general_rules.action: Use dashes or bullets for list items

general_rules.name: cc_for_technical_lead
general_rules.description: CC Pierre (technical lead) on technical or external discussions
general_rules.trigger: External partnerships with technical aspects or internal technical validation

general_rules.name: concise_replies
general_rules.description: Keep replies short and direct for quick exchanges
